blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Moody Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Moody Park with a median price of $1,546,500 (the middle half sold between $1,282,500 and $1,732,500), taking a median of 9 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 18% sold above list. They had a median $550 per square foot, a median year built of 1926 and a median lot of 6,435 square feet.

A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Moody Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 7 houses listed in Moody Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Moody Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Moody Park had a sales ratio of 29% on only 7 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Moody Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Moody Park over those 5 months, out of 75 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Moody Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Moody Park sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Moody Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,546,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Moody Park?
faq.a: The median was 9 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (18% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
